name: 格纹衬衫外套秋冬百搭款
description: 格纹衬衫式外套套版：上新主推、上身卖点、街拍场景、面料细节、尺码规格到限时收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: white grid-paper layout #F6F4F0 with photo content mounted inside flat rounded-corner amber tiles #E9A93E; charcoal #2B2724 bands reserved for labels and CTA bars
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even studio light with a gentle front or front-left key, soft natural shadows, warm-neutral tone; lifestyle shots use golden-hour side sunlight at 5500K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: flat matte paper backdrop for studio shots; asphalt sidewalk and blurred urban street for scene shots
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif for English headlines, clean heavy CJK sans-serif for Chinese labels wrapped in 「」, white text on charcoal bands
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line white icons only, used inside charcoal bands, single line weight
styleLock.presentationRules: product always the single hero subject, worn open by a generic male model or laid flat; stable scale across the set; no props covering the product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent autumn menswear street-casual ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm amber accent #E9A93E, deep charcoal #2B2724, paper white #FFFFFF and light grid-paper texture background #F6F4F0; warm-neutral tone; bold modern geometric sans-serif for English headlines and clean heavy CJK sans-serif for Chinese labels in 「」; photo content mounted inside flat rounded-corner amber tiles on a white grid-paper layout; thin-line white icons only inside charcoal bands; bright even studio light with a gentle front or front-left key and soft natural shadows; product always the single hero subject, worn by a generic male model or laid flat, stable scale, text columns composed with balanced weight against the photo tiles; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 上新氛围开场，一秒传达主推款与促销钩子，赢得点击
shots.camera: full-body frontal eye-level shot, generic male model centered in the right panel
shots.lighting: bright even studio light from the front, soft contact shadow under the shoes
shots.background: split layout: right two-thirds flat amber panel #E9A93E, left one-third white grid-paper column #F6F4F0
shots.textZone: left column: letter-spaced English headline 「{callout_4}」, short Chinese headline 「{callout_1}」, supporting line 「{selling_point_1}」, small rounded bubble 「{callout_2}」, bottom full-width charcoal bar 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo hero of {product} worn open over a plain tee by a generic male model shown from the neck down, full body frontal eye-level pose centered on the right panel. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Split layout: right two-thirds a flat amber panel #E9A93E with the model, left one-third a white grid-paper column #F6F4F0 carrying the copy stack. Bright even studio light from the front with a soft contact shadow grounding the model. The model occupies 50-60% of the frame on the amber panel. Left column carries a letter-spaced English headline 「{callout_4}」, a short Chinese headline 「{callout_1}」 and a supporting line 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B2724, plus a small rounded bubble 「{callout_2}」 and a bottom charcoal bar #2B2724 with white text 「{callout_3}」, the type stack filling the column from top to bottom. Negative: no recognizable face, no brand names or logos, no QR code, no watermark, no real discount numbers, no distorted hands, no extra text beyond the listed copy, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 用一张干净的上身瓷砖图加一句主张，一秒说清百搭易穿的核心利益
shots.camera: slight 3/4 waist-up angle inside a left rounded photo tile, face cropped above the chin
shots.lighting: soft front-left studio key light, gentle shadow inside the tile
shots.background: left rounded-corner amber tile #E9A93E, right white grid-paper #F6F4F0
shots.textZone: right column: letter-spaced English headline 「{callout_2}」, large Chinese headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B2724, black label bar with white text 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A rounded-corner amber photo tile #E9A93E on the left shows {product} worn open by a generic male model at a slight 3/4 waist-up angle, face cropped above the chin. Right side clean white grid-paper background #F6F4F0 with a letter-spaced English headline 「{callout_2}」, a large Chinese headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B2724 and a charcoal label bar #2B2724 carrying white text 「{callout_1}」, the type stack filling the right column. Soft front-left studio key light, gentle shadow inside the tile. The tile occupies 45-50% of the frame, the garment filling most of the tile at 35-45% of the frame. Negative: no recognizable face, no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented fabric claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 真实街拍代入感，让买家把外套套进自己的日常出行
shots.camera: slightly low angle looking up, rear three-quarter view at eye level, mid-stride on a city sidewalk
shots.lighting: natural golden-hour side sunlight, 5500K, soft long shadows on the pavement
shots.background: blurred warm-neutral urban street, asphalt sidewalk #8A8580 tones
shots.props: one plain tote bag carried by the model, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: natural breathing margins of the street composition
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle street scene of {product} worn by a generic male model photographed from a slightly low angle looking up, rear three-quarter view, mid-stride on a city sidewalk in autumn. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Natural golden-hour side sunlight at 5500K with soft long shadows on the pavement. Blurred warm-neutral urban background; one plain tote bag as the only prop, not covering the product. The model and product occupy 40-50% of the frame with the street composition breathing naturally around them. Optional short lower-third label 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2724. Negative: no recognizable face, no distorted hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered background, no duplicated background people.

shots.intent: 微距证明面料织法与质感，落地品质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground threads sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right at a low 45-degree angle revealing the woven texture
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the plaid woven fabric of {product}, tight zoom on the weave and yarn texture. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground threads sharp. Raking side light from the right at a low 45-degree angle revealing the woven texture. Neutral matte light-grey background #F6F4F0. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a slim natural margin around the weave. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fabric composition claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 用领口、袖口、口袋三个局部特写证明版型与做工
shots.camera: three stacked tiles: collar and placket from a high 45-degree angle, cuff and sleeve opening from a clean 90-degree side profile, chest pocket from a slight 3/4 close-up
shots.lighting: soft even studio light with gentle directional highlights inside each tile
shots.background: three rounded-corner amber tiles #E9A93E on white grid-paper #F6F4F0
shots.textZone: one short white label per tile in a charcoal band #2B2724: 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic of {product} details in a three-tile vertical layout, each tile a rounded-corner amber panel #E9A93E on white grid-paper #F6F4F0. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Tile one: close-up of the collar and front placket photographed from a high 45-degree angle. Tile two: side profile close-up of the cuff and sleeve opening. Tile three: slight 3/4 close-up of the chest pocket. Soft even studio light with gentle directional highlights in every tile. Each tile carries one short white label in a charcoal band #2B2724: 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」. Details occupy 60-65% overall with the tiles stacked edge to edge and slim even gutters between them. Negative: no recognizable face, no tiny unreadable text, no duplicated tiles, no invented material claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 平铺尺寸标注加通用尺码表，消除会不会合身的疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, front view
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.textZone: thin dimension callout lines in #2B2724 with value tokens 「{callout_2}」, a generic size table with generic column headers and value tokens 「{callout_3}」, one short note 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic of {product} laid flat, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, front view. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. White grid-paper background #F6F4F0. Clean thin dimension callout lines in #2B2724 pointing to shoulder, chest, body length and sleeve, each ending in a short value token 「{callout_2}」 standing in for the real measurements, plus a generic size table with generic column headers and value tokens 「{callout_3}」 and one short note 「{callout_1}」. The garment occupies 55-60% of the frame with the dimension lines and table arranged around it. Negative: no fabricated measurement numbers, no dense body text, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 三条亲测向卖点加真实面料细节背书，降低下单风险
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, product folded neatly on the left, trust band on the right
shots.background: white grid-paper #F6F4F0 with a charcoal band #2B2724 on the right
shots.props: one small macro tile of the plaid fabric as tangible material evidence
shots.textZone: charcoal band with three thin-line white icons and short labels 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」, 「{selling_point_3}」, plus one small fabric macro tile
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product folded neatly at a slight 3/4 angle on the left; right side a charcoal band #2B2724 with three thin-line white icons and short labels 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」, 「{selling_point_3}」, plus one small macro tile of the plaid fabric as tangible material evidence. Background white grid-paper #F6F4F0, even clean studio light. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame on the left half with the trust band balancing the right. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, ratings, test data or review quotes; no fabricated badges, no QR code, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 暖色主视觉加优惠气泡和行动条，收口促单
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, generic male model shown from the neck down, centered
shots.lighting: bright even front studio light with a soft contact shadow, slightly punchier contrast
shots.textZone: white offer bubble 「{callout_1}」 above the model, full-width charcoal bar #2B2724 with white CTA text 「{callout_2}」 below
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product} worn by a generic male model shown from the neck down at a slight 3/4 angle, centered on a flat amber panel #E9A93E. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even studio light from the front with a soft contact shadow, slightly punchier contrast. A white offer bubble 「{callout_1}」 sits above the model, and a full-width charcoal bar #2B2724 with white CTA text 「{callout_2}」 sits below, the copy elements anchoring the open amber field above and below the model. The model occupies 60-70% of the frame. Negative: no real discount numbers or countdowns, no QR code, no member badges, no recognizable face, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text beyond the listed copy.

provenance.notes: 从 7 张男装格纹衬衫外套爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离源模特身份与面部、原文案、促销数字、会员徽标与二维码；源图面料口径矛盾（纯棉/腈纶），模板一律不作成分声明，缺失证据不作虚构、以真实面料微距细节承接；产品以 {product} 占位。
